newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's NCB says in talks with Bankers Trust.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NCB says in talks with Bankers Trust.

text.p: Japan's Nippon Credit Bank, in the course of a restructuring, is in the "final stages" of talks on a business tie-up with Bankers Trust New York Corp, an NCB spokesman said on Thursday.
Japan's financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that NCB and Bankers Trust were considering a capital tie-up.
"I cannot confirm the details of the report, but I understand it is not a capital tie-up but some sort of business tie-up," a spokesman for NCB told Reuters.

A spokesman for Bankers Trust said in New York on Wednesday that it was hired to assist NCB in the securitisation of its assets. The Bankers Trust spokesman said NCB was expected to make a formal announcement of the "business collaboration" on Thursday.
Kidd said "the two institutions would discuss a very limited equity participation" when the NCB's capital restructuring is completed.

NCB, in financial trouble due to a heavy burden of problem loans, announced earlier this month that it was undertaking a radical restructuring that included closing its overseas operations and sales of real estate to raise capital.
At the time of the announcement, NCB said it was looking for deals with foreign banks.
